notes:
Summary: large regional health system evaluating private/VPC deployment for several patient-facing and clinician workflows. High sensitivity to where PHI/PII can reside.

Key quote from CISO (02/28): "All model hosts, backups and logs must remain physically in EU and under EU jurisdiction — no US processing or failover permitted."

Recent touchpoints: AE went through pricing and dedicated capacity options (Maya). SE (Liam) ran an architecture call 02/14; legal/security follow-up 03/03. Procurement timeline slipped after internal org change (VP of IT left).

Why deal stalled/closed-lost: Redwood could offer private deployment but control plane/backup policy could not be constrained to EU-only regions to satisfy their legal team. Competitor (EuroCloudAI) presented a contractually-bound EU-only hosting model and won the procurement.

Sales notes / shorthand:
- Strong technical fit: batching/kv-cache + RD runtime looked good for throughput (10k reqs/day peak).
- Latency target: 150-200ms p50 for chat (regional clinics).
- Cost sensitivity: mid (wants predictable reserved capacity).
- Security asks: SAML, audit logs with 10y retention, HSM/KMS, SOC2+ISO27001.
- Blocker: explicit data residency requirement (no US-sited control plane, no backups outside EU) — legal refused vendor unless guaranteed in contract.

Next steps suggested at close: capture redlines, save artifacts for potential winback when Redwood can offer EU-only residency guarantee. Marked closed-lost for this RFx.

Helpful refs: pricing deck link and security FAQ above; call transcripts in Fireflies IDs.
